findingClosedDuringReview.class: P2 currency crop with invisible formatting characters
findingClosedDuringReview.firstObservation: USD\u200B¥8000 or JP\u200B¥8000 with value/quote=¥8000 retained exact 8000.00 RMB precision. Relationship warning blocked due suggestions, but the Panel still displayed normalized yuan.
findingClosedDuringReview.rootFix: Currency detection copies now use NFKC and remove Unicode Cf after computing original source offsets; line boundaries remain intact.
findingClosedDuringReview.independentRetest: 4/4 PASS: USD/JP with ZWSP, USD with ZWJ and suffix USD after WORD JOINER now have null amount/normalization.amount, unsupported status, no due suggestion and unchanged raw/representation.

lexicalBoundaryClosedDuringReview.initialObservation: The 元 inside 元旦 could previously provide exact 8000.00 precision, although a relationship warning withheld total suggestions.
lexicalBoundaryClosedDuringReview.rootFix: The supported unit boundary excludes explicit non-currency words and checks the token's unit character together with its original source edge. Independent RMB markers remain valid.
lexicalBoundaryClosedDuringReview.independentRetest: 元旦 and 元宵, each with value=8000 or value=8000元, now have null precision. ¥8000元旦 and ¥8000元宵 positive controls keep 8000.00 because the independent symbol establishes currency. All raw and representations remain unchanged.

acceptanceEvidence: Bare zero, grouped/decimal amounts and multipliers do not acquire RMB precision without an attached supported marker.
Currency from another amount, clause, line, U+2028 or U+2029 is not borrowed.
Attached RMB/CNY, fullwidth equivalents, yuan symbols and financial Chinese literals keep positive precision.
Cropped regional yen and mixed foreign markers are unavailable, including Unicode formatting-character separators after the root correction.
Date meaning must match its own explicit local event; receipt, signing, performance, wage coverage, actual employment and injury/raise events are not interchangeable.
Cropped calendar components/interval boundaries, a second date, mixed event roles, payer dates and dates without an event all retain review warnings.
Final date helper accepts full parallel wage periods and explicit wage-payment coverage labels; cropping the second period remains unresolved.
Existing real D1 API tests pass extract/reload/scope review and independently attested manual due=9000 and paid=0 calculation; raw remains stored.
Actual user confirmations, explicit zero, scope and audit are preserved when a date role needs review; frozen v2 state is not upgraded or rewritten.
scopeAndLimits: Production files were read only. All new reviewer scripts/reports are in /tmp; no commit, push or deployment.
Frozen v3 and types were not edited by the reviewer; Git product diff remains limited to root-owned currency/event/source guards.
Date acceptance is a conservative finite vocabulary, not a complete language or calendar validity parser; unsupported prose remains for human review.
No new browser or production HTTP environment was launched. D1 API evidence comes from executed focused tests; actual Panel wording was checked in source, not a newly rendered browser.
Full project check is root-owned and was not rerun by this reviewer.
